title: Benefits Of River Ganga
definition: The Ganga is a transboundary river of the Indian subcontinent, serving as a vital hydrological, socio-economic, and ecological lifeline for the Indo-Gangetic Plain, supporting one-third of India's population.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested under GS Paper I (Geography), GS Paper III (Environment/Economy), and Essay papers due to its role in food security, cultural heritage, and climate resilience.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Benefits Of River Ganga.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Indian Drainage System
